record_type_quote: We replicate this finding within the German multiparty context, performing a direct replication with minimal modifications to the original design.

targets.authors: Braley, A., Lenz, G.S., Adjodah, D. et al.
targets.title: Why voters who value democracy participate in democratic backsliding
targets.evidence_quote: Our focus centers specifically on the original study's primary effect – the impact of the ask-tell treatment on respondents' democratic commitment (Study 2 in the original research).
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication corroborates the principal finding from the original study: correcting misperceptions about opponents' democratic commitments significantly reduces respondents' willingness to undermine democratic norms themselves.

reasoning: A new German sample directly tests the published experimental finding; the authors explicitly corroborate the principal finding. Title differs in subtitle from assigned metadata, but authors, focal original and German multiparty design match.
